paragraphs: Markets over the last day: the eight tracked equity indices moved +0.13% on average, with Nikkei 225 strongest (+1.31%) and Hang Seng weakest (-0.98%). Brent crude changed +1.31% to 92.69. Gold changed +0.63% to 4,055.6001. Bitcoin changed +0.23% to 73,891.2188. The US 10-year yield stands at 4.983%, a relative move of +2.45%. Among the firms tracked, Gold Miners (ETF) (-5.43%) and Newmont (-4.15%) moved the most.
